name: 08865 · Phillipsburg, NJ
findings: ZIP 08865 (Phillipsburg) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08865 (Phillipsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08865 (Phillipsburg) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
